overall: The AG found the Granby Zoning Enforcement Committee fits the Connelly exception, so it is not a public body under the Open Meeting Law and no violation occurred. The AG separately found the Board's minutes wrongly described a vote and reminded the Board of its minutes obligation.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Zoning Enforcement Committee has not posted notice of its meetings or created minutes for two years.
allegations.key_passage: we conclude that the Committee was not a public body subject to the requirements of the Open Meeting Law, and we therefore find no violation of the Law.
